name: smwsprites-baron-von-zeppelin
title: Baron Von Zeppelin
description:
The little balloon from SMW2:YI which holds a configurable sprite. Green Needlenose is also included.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Pack 2, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

DrAnas update: fixed two major oversights reported by MegaSonic1999 where the extra bit option for the Baron von Zeppelin to respawn after dropping its payload didn't actually work and running away from the Baron von Zeppelin after approaching it would permanently despawn it. Also, all previously-hardcoded sprite-related defines are now extra byte options!

- Extra byte 1 = How close Mario should get in order to drop payload.
- Extra byte 2 = carried sprite is custom or normal? - 0 = normal. 1 = custom.
- Extra byte 3 = carried sprite number.
- Extra byte 4 = 16x16 tile to use for the carried sprite.
- Extra byte 5 = tile properties for carried sprite, YXPPCCCT format.
